documents.text: Macdonell ( 1862–1911 ) by Frank Farrell This article was published : in the Australian Dictionary of Biography , Volume 10 online in 1986 This entry is from the Australian Dictionary of Biography Donald Macdonell ( 1862-1911 ) , shearer , trade unionist and politician , was born in January 1862 at Stuart Mill , Victoria , son of Alexander Macdonell , Scottish migrant of Catholic Highland extraction , and his wife , Christina née McMaster . His parents were hard working , industrious and frugal and imparted these virtues to Donald and his brother and sisters . From boyhood
